l-m-e4-b04-26.title: Sheegidda 180° marka loo eego xagallo qumman
l-m-e4-b04-26.goal: U beddel xagalka uu sameeyo xariiq toosan, 180°, qaab kale oo muujin ah (isle'eg, jadwal, sawir, erayo), oo sharax sababta ay macnaha isku mid u tahay.
l-m-e4-b04-26.material: Xagalka uu sameeyo xariiq toosan waa 180°. Annagoo adeegsanayna xaqiiqda ah in xagal qumman yahay 90°, waxaan rabnaa inaan dib u sheegno 180° inta xagal qumman ay tahay.
l-m-e4-b04-26.s.s1.prompt: Hadalkee ayaa muujinaya cabbir la mid ah 180°?
l-m-e4-b04-26.s.s1.explain: 1 xagal oo qumman waa 90°, sidaas darteed 90°+90°=180°. Taasi waxay ka dhigtaa mid la mid ah 2 xagal oo qumman.
l-m-e4-b04-26.s.s2.model.0: Hal xagal oo qumman waa 90° iyo 90°+90°=180°, sidaas darteed 180° waa la mid 2 xagal oo qumman.
l-m-e4-b04-26.s.s2.model.1: Marka aad dhigto laba xagal oo qumman is garab, waxay sameeyaan xariiq toosan, sidaas darteed 180° waad ku sheegi kartaa 2 xagal oo qumman.

l-m-e4-b04-27.title: U beddelidda sheekada isku xidhka xargaha isle'eg
l-m-e4-b04-27.goal: U beddel dhererka laba xarig oo is-xidhan qaab kale oo muujin ah (isle'eg, jadwal, sawir, erayo), oo sharax sababta ay macnaha isku mid u tahay.
l-m-e4-b04-27.material: Haddii xarig cas ah oo 1.4 m dhererkiisu yahay iyo xarig buluug ah oo 0.75 m dhererkiisu yahay hal safka lagu xidho, waxaan rabnaa inaan ogaano inta m ee guud ahaan jirta. U beddel sheekadan isle'eg.
l-m-e4-b04-27.s.s1.r.a: Isku xidhku wuxuu ka dhigaa dhererka mid ka weyn, sidaas darteed ma aha dhimis.
l-m-e4-b04-27.s.s1.r.b: Dhererka la isku xidhay waa wadarta, maaha wadarta dhufashada.
l-m-e4-b04-27.s.s1.r.d: 0.75 ayaa si khalad ah loo koobiyeeyay sida 7.5. Tobanaad-dhibcuhu wuxuu ku jiraa meel kale.
l-m-e4-b04-27.s.s1.explain: Marka aad laba xarig isku xidho, dhererka ayaad isku darta. 1.4+0.75=2.15, sidaas darteed waa 2.15 m.
l-m-e4-b04-27.s.s2.model.0: Isku xidhka xargaha wuxuu ka dhigayaa inay dhererkoodu le'eg yahay labada dherer oo la isku daray, sidaas darteed waxaad u qori kartaa 1.4+0.75.
l-m-e4-b04-27.s.s2.model.1: 0.75 m ayaa lagu daray dhererkii asalka ahaa ee 1.4 m, sidaas darteed isle'egta isku darka 1.4+0.75 waxay macno ahaan la mid tahay sheekada.

l-m-e4-b04-28.goal: U beddel hadalka "laba xariiq oo toosan way isu toosan yihiin" qaab kale oo muujin ah (isle'eg, jadwal, sawir, erayo), oo sharax sababta ay macnaha isku mid u tahay.
l-m-e4-b04-28.material: Xariiqda A iyo xariiqda B way isu toosan yihiin. Waxaan rabnaa inaan tan dib ugu qorno erayo kale oo macne isku mid ah leh.
l-m-e4-b04-28.s.s1.prompt: Hadalkee ayaa macne isku mid ah leh?
l-m-e4-b04-28.s.s1.o.a: Labada xariiq way kulmaan oo waxay sameeyaan xagal qumman
l-m-e4-b04-28.s.s1.o.b: Labada xariiq way kulmaan oo waxay sameeyaan xagal ballaaran
l-m-e4-b04-28.s.s1.r.b: Waa inay sameeyaan xagal qumman, maaha xagal ballaaran, si ay isu toosan yihiin.
l-m-e4-b04-28.s.s1.r.c: Laba xariiq oo aan kulmin waa is-barbar socda. Isu toosan ma aha.
l-m-e4-b04-28.s.s1.o.d: Labada xariiq dhererkoodu waa isku mid
l-m-e4-b04-28.s.s1.r.d: Xariiq toosan ma laha dherer go'an, dhererkuna ma laha wax xiriir ah isu-toosnaanta.
l-m-e4-b04-28.s.s1.explain: Marka xagalka ay sameeyaan laba xariiq oo kulma yahay xagal qumman, waxaan ku nidhaahnaa way isu toosan yihiin.
l-m-e4-b04-28.s.s2.model.0: "Isu toosan" macnaheedu waa in xagalka la sameeyo meesha laba xariiq ay kulmaan yahay xagal qumman, sidaas darteed waa la mid "way kulmaan oo waxay sameeyaan xagal qumman."
l-m-e4-b04-28.s.s2.model.1: Labada xariiq waxay ku kulmaan hal barood xagalkuna waa 90°, sidaas darteed waa hab kale oo lagu yidhaahdo "isu toosan."

l-m-e4-b04-29.goal: U beddel sheekada u qaybinta kubbadaha si siman qaab kale oo muujin ah (isle'eg, jadwal, sawir, erayo), oo sharax sababta ay macnaha isku mid u tahay.
l-m-e4-b04-29.material: Waxaan rabnaa inaan ogaano inta kiish oo loo baahan yahay haddii 120 kubbadood lagu dhigo kiishyo, 15 kubbadood kiish kasta. Ha noqdo tirada kiishyada □ oo sheekada u beddel isle'eg.
l-m-e4-b04-29.s.s1.r.a: Qaybiyaha iyo la-qaybiyaha waa la kala beddelay.
l-m-e4-b04-29.s.s1.r.b: Ku darista waxay bixisaa tirada guud ee kubbadaha, maaha tirada kiishyada.
l-m-e4-b04-29.s.s1.r.d: Ku dhufashadu waxay ka dhigtaa tirada kubbadaha mid aad u weyn. Tani waa xaalad qaybin iyo baakadayn ah.
l-m-e4-b04-29.s.s1.explain: Waxaad u kooxeynaysaa 120 kooxo ah 15, sidaas darteed 120÷15=□. Waxay noqotaa 8, sidaas darteed 8 kiish ayaa loo baahan yahay.
l-m-e4-b04-29.s.s2.model.0: 120-ka oo dhan waxaa loo qaybiyay kooxo ah 15, sidaas darteed waad qori kartaa 120÷15=□.
l-m-e4-b04-29.s.s2.model.1: Tirada guud ee kubbadaha waa la-qaybiyaha 15-ka ku jira hal kiish-na waa qaybiyaha, sidaas darteed 120÷15=□.

l-m-e4-b04-30.title: Sheegidda "saddex-geesood dhinacyo siman" marka loo eego xagallada
l-m-e4-b04-30.goal: U beddel "saddex-geesood saddexdiisa dhinac dhammaantood dhererkoodu isku mid yahay" qaab kale oo muujin ah (isle'eg, jadwal, sawir, erayo), oo sharax sababta ay macnaha isku mid u tahay.
l-m-e4-b04-30.material: Saddex-geesood saddexdiisa dhinac dhammaantood dhererkoodu isku mid yahay waa saddex-geesood dhinacyo siman. Waxaan rabnaa inaan tan ku sheegno cabbirrada xagallada halkii dhinacyada.
l-m-e4-b04-30.s.s1.prompt: Hadalkee ayaa qeexitaanka saddex-geesoodka dhinacyada siman u beddelaya xagallo?
l-m-e4-b04-30.s.s1.r.b: Wadarta saddexda xagal waa 180°, sidaas darteed ma noqon karaan 90° mid kasta.
l-m-e4-b04-30.s.s1.r.c: Haddii xagal qumman jiro, dhererka dhinacyadu dhammaantood isku mid noqon maayaan.
l-m-e4-b04-30.s.s1.r.d: Saddex-geesood dhinacyada siman, dhammaan saddexda xagal waa siman yihiin, maaha kaliya laba.
l-m-e4-b04-30.s.s1.explain: Haddii saddexda dhinac dhammaantood siman yihiin, saddexda xagal sidoo kale waa siman yihiin, wadartooduna waa 180°, sidaas darteed hal xagal waa 180°÷3=60°.
l-m-e4-b04-30.s.s2.model.0: Haddii saddexda dhinac dhammaantood siman yihiin, saddexda xagal waa siman yihiin oo waxay isku darmaan 180°, sidaas darteed hal xagal waa 60°.
l-m-e4-b04-30.s.s2.model.1: Saddex-geesood dhinacyada siman waa inuu lahaadaa saddex xagal oo siman, sidaas darteed macnaheedu waa isku mid saddex-geesood xagal kasta yahay 180°÷3=60°.

l-m-e4-b05-26.title: Dib u sheegidda rogid ilaa midig
l-m-e4-b05-26.goal: Dib u sheeg qaabka laga helo markii qaab loo rogo midig qaab kale (jajab xisaabeed, miis, sawir, ama erayo), oo sharax sababta ay isku macne u tahay.
l-m-e4-b05-26.material: Qaab ayaa loo rogay midig. Waxaad rabtaa inaad erayo ku hesho dhaqdhaqaaq kale oo siinaya isla natiijada rogidda.
l-m-e4-b05-26.s.s1.prompt: Dhaqdhaqaaqee ayaa siinaya isla qaabka marka midig loo rogo?
l-m-e4-b05-26.s.s1.r.b: Wareejintu waxay wareejisaa jihada qaabka, sidaa darteed way ka duwan tahay qaabka la rogay.
l-m-e4-b05-26.s.s1.r.c: Rogidda kor waxay beddeshaa kore iyo hoose, sidaa darteed way ka duwan tahay qaabka midigta iyo bidixda la beddelay.
l-m-e4-b05-26.s.s1.r.d: Simbiririxidu ma beddesho midigta iyo bidixda qaabka.
l-m-e4-b05-26.s.s1.explain: Haddii aad u rogto midig ama bidix, waxaad heshaa qaab midigtiisa iyo bidixdiisa la beddelay.
l-m-e4-b05-26.s.s2.model.0: Shaxda midig loo rogay iyo shaxda bidix loo rogay labaduba waxay kala beddelaan bidix iyo midig, sidaas darteed waa isku mid.
l-m-e4-b05-26.s.s2.model.1: Dhinac kasta oo cidhifkiisa aad ku rogto, bidix iyo midig way is beddelaan, sidaas darteed waa isla shaxda lagu rogay bidix.

l-m-e4-b05-27.title: Dib u qorista qadarka ka yimid shubidda 1/2 L saddex jeer
l-m-e4-b05-27.goal: Dib u sheeg qadarka biyaha saddex jeer lagu shubay koob 1/2 L ah qaab kale (muujin, jadwal, sawir, ama erayo), oo sharax sababta ay macnaha isku mid u tahay.
l-m-e4-b05-27.material: Biyo ayaa saddex jeer lagu shubay koob 1/2 L ah ibriiq ku jira. U qor qadarka biyaha la shubay sida 1/2+1/2+1/2, oo u muuji tiro isku dhafan.
l-m-e4-b05-27.s.s1.r.a: Tani waa qiimaha tirada dhan 3 iyo 1/2 oo la isku qoray.
l-m-e4-b05-27.s.s1.r.b: Tani waa qadar ka yar 1/2. Marka saddex jeer la isku daro waxay dhaafaysaa 1 L.
l-m-e4-b05-27.s.s1.r.c: Tani waxay ku darsaday hooseeyayaasha sidoo kale. Hooseeyuhu wuxuu ahaanayaa 2.
l-m-e4-b05-27.s.s1.explain: 1/2+1/2+1/2=3/2. Maadaama 3/2 yahay 2/2=1 iyo 1/2, waa 1 iyo 1/2 L.
l-m-e4-b05-27.s.s2.model.0: Marka jajabyadu leeyihiin hooseeye isku mid ah, waxaad ku darsataa korreeyayaasha oo keliya, sidaas darteed waa 3/2, 3/2-na waa 1 iyo 1/2.
l-m-e4-b05-27.s.s2.model.1: Laba shub oo 1/2 L ah waxay sameeyaan 1 L, hal shub oo kale-na waxay ka dhigtaa 1 iyo 1/2 L.

l-m-e4-b01-40.title: Doorashada saddexda xagal ee saddex-xagal ku habboon shuruudaha
l-m-e4-b01-40.goal: Go'aaminta saddexda xagal ee saddex-xagal, miisaan shuruud kasta oo is-hortaagaysa, dooro heshiiska ugu habboon, oo sharax sababta.
l-m-e4-b01-40.material: Go'aami saddexda xagal ee saddex-xagal. Shuruudaha: hal xagal waa bararsan, labada xagal ee kale cabbirkoodu waa isle'eg, wadarta saddexda xagalna waa inay raacdaa xeerka saddex-xagallada.
l-m-e4-b01-40.s.s1.prompt: Saddexda xagal ee kee ayaa raacaya shuruudaha oo dhan?
l-m-e4-b01-40.s.s1.r.a: Labada xagal ee kale, 25° iyo 35°, isle'eg ma aha.
l-m-e4-b01-40.s.s1.r.c: Wadartu waa 185°, sidaas darteed ma noqon karaan saddexda xagal ee saddex-xagal.
l-m-e4-b01-40.s.s1.r.d: 90° waa xagal qumman, sidaas darteed maaha bararsan.
l-m-e4-b01-40.s.s1.explain: 110° waa bararsan, 35° iyo 35° waa isle'eg yihiin, wadartuna waa 180°.
l-m-e4-b01-40.s.s2.model.0: 110°+35°+35°=180°, 110° waa bararsan, labada xagal ee kalena waa isle'eg yihiin, sidaas darteed saddexdan xagal waa sax.
l-m-e4-b01-40.s.s2.model.1: Wadartu waa inay noqotaa 180°, midna ma noqon karo xagal qumman, labada xagalna waa inaysan kala duwanayn, sidaas darteed kuwa keliya ee raacaya saddexda shuruudood oo dhan waa 110°, 35°, 35°.

l-m-e4-b02-08.title: U qaybinta deeqda saddex dugsi
l-m-e4-b02-08.goal: Habka loo qaybinayo deeq ah 1 boqol milyan won, miisaan dhammaan shuruudaha is khilaafsan, dooro heshiiska ugu habboon, oo sharax sababta.
l-m-e4-b02-08.material: U qaybi deeqda oo dhan ee 1 boqol milyan won saddexda dugsi A, B, iyo C. Shuruudaha: dugsi kasta wuxuu helayaa ugu yaraan 2 toban milyan won, A wuxuu helayaa wax ka badan B, qadarka saddexda dugsi waa inay dhammaan kala duwanaadaan.
l-m-e4-b02-08.s.s1.prompt: Habkee qaybinta ayaa raacaya dhammaan shuruudaha?
l-m-e4-b02-08.s.s1.o.a: A 3 toban milyan, B 4 toban milyan, C 3 toban milyan
l-m-e4-b02-08.s.s1.r.a: A waa ka yar yahay B, qadarkuna wuu is-dul saaran yahay.
l-m-e4-b02-08.s.s1.o.b: A 5 toban milyan, B 3 toban milyan, C 2 toban milyan
l-m-e4-b02-08.s.s1.o.c: A 4 toban milyan, B 3 toban milyan, C 3 toban milyan
l-m-e4-b02-08.s.s1.r.c: B iyo C waa isku mid, markaa qadarka dhammaantood kuma kala duwana.
l-m-e4-b02-08.s.s1.o.d: A 6 toban milyan, B 3 toban milyan, C 1 toban milyan
l-m-e4-b02-08.s.s1.r.d: C wuxuu helayaa wax ka yar 2 toban milyan won.
l-m-e4-b02-08.s.s1.explain: Kan keliya ee wadarkiisu yahay 1 boqol milyan, dhammaantood yihiin ugu yaraan 2 toban milyan, A ka badan yahay B, oo dhammaantood kala duwan yihiin waa 5 toban milyan, 3 toban milyan, 2 toban milyan.
l-m-e4-b02-08.s.s2.model.0: 5 toban milyan+3 toban milyan+2 toban milyan=1 boqol milyan, dhammaantood waa ugu yaraan 2 toban milyan, A wuu ka badan yahay B, oo dhammaantood kala duwan yihiin, sidaas darteed way ku habboon tahay.
l-m-e4-b02-08.s.s2.model.1: Qorshayaasha kale qadarkoodu wuu is-dul saaran yahay, waxay ka kooban yihiin 1 toban milyan won, ama A wuu ka yar yahay B, sidaas darteed qorshahani waa kan raacaya dhammaan shuruudaha.

l-m-e4-b02-16.goal: Tixgeli shuruudaha is khilaafsan ee ku saabsan sida buugaagta loogu xirxiro sanduuqyada, dooro heshiiska ugu habboon, oo sharax sababta.

l-m-e4-b02-16.s.s1.o.a: 30 buug sanduuq kasta oo ka mid ah 6 sanduuq
l-m-e4-b02-16.s.s1.r.a: Hal sanduuq wuxuu qaadi lahaa in ka badan 20 buug.
l-m-e4-b02-16.s.s1.o.b: 20 buug sanduuq kasta oo ka mid ah 9 sanduuq
l-m-e4-b02-16.s.s1.o.c: 18 buug sanduuq kasta oo ka mid ah 10 sanduuq
l-m-e4-b02-16.s.s1.r.c: Shuruudda way ilaalinaysaa, laakiin waxaa sidoo kale lagu xirxiri karaa 9 sanduuq.
l-m-e4-b02-16.s.s1.o.d: 15 buug sanduuq kasta oo ka mid ah 12 sanduuq
l-m-e4-b02-16.s.s1.r.d: Shuruudda way ilaalinaysaa, laakiin waxay isticmaalaysaa sanduuqyo badan.
l-m-e4-b02-16.s.s1.explain: Marka sanduuq kasta uu leeyahay 20 buug, waxay u baahan tahay 9 sanduuq, haddii ay jiraan wax ka yar 9 sanduuq, hal sanduuq wuxuu qaadayaa in ka badan 20 buug.

l-m-e4-b02-24.goal: Tixgeli shuruudaha is khilaafsan ee gaanbo afargeesle dherer leh oo laga sameeyay ribaan, dooro heshiiska ugu habboon, oo sharax sababta.
l-m-e4-b02-24.material: Isticmaal dhammaan 40 cm ribaan si aad u samayso gaanbo afargeesle dherer leh. Shuruudaha: dhererka iyo ballaadhku waa tirooyin dhan oo kala duwan oo cm ah, geesta dheer waa ugu badnaan 12 cm, oo ka dhig mid ugu ballaadhan ee suurtagalka ah.
l-m-e4-b02-24.s.s1.prompt: Dhererka×ballaadhka kee ayaa shuruudaha ugu fiican ku habboon?

l-m-e4-b02-24.s.s1.r.c: Shuruudaha way ilaalinaysaa, laakiin bedku waa ka yar yahay, isagoo ah 96.
l-m-e4-b02-24.s.s1.r.d: Dhererka iyo ballaadhku way isku mid yihiin, sidaas darteed shuruudaha way jebinayaa.
l-m-e4-b02-24.s.s1.explain: Haddii wareeggu yahay 40 cm, isku darka dhererka iyo ballaadhku waa 20 cm. Doorashooyinka ilaaliya shuruudaha ka mid ah, 11×9, oo leh bed 99, waa kan ugu ballaadhan.
l-m-e4-b02-24.s.s2.model.0: Isku darka dhererka iyo ballaadhku waa 20, 11 iyo 9 way kala duwan yihiin, oo doorashooyinka 12 ama ka yar ka mid ah, bedka 99 waa kan ugu ballaadhan, sidaas darteed 11×9 ayaa ku habboon.
l-m-e4-b02-24.s.s2.model.1: 10×10 waxay leedahay dherer siman, 15×5 waxay dhaaftay 12, 12×8 na waxay leedahay bed 96, taas oo ka yar 11×9 oo leh 99, sidaas darteed 11×9 ayaa ugu haboon.
